body:
⚡ EasyCommands — Instant Command Shortcuts for Your Server
Stop typing long commands. EasyCommands lets you create custom aliases for any command on your server — fully configurable in a simple config.yml, no coding needed.
✨ Features:

Custom Aliases — Map any command to a shorter version. /gmc for /gamemode creative, /gms for /gamemode survival, /fly for /togglefly — whatever fits your server.
Easy Configuration — Add, remove or change aliases in seconds. Just edit the config, do a quick reload and you're done.
Works with Any Command — Compatible with vanilla commands and other plugins. If it's a command on your server, you can shorten it.
Lightweight & Fast — No bloat, no unnecessary features. Just clean, instant command shortcuts that stay out of the way.
Permission Support — Restrict certain aliases to specific player ranks so only the right people have access.

⚙️ Perfect for:
Staff members, power users, and any server that wants a faster, cleaner command experience for players and admins alike.
